questions.q: In 'The Bear and the Bees', what did the Bear do right after one Bee stung him?
choices: Attacked the log to destroy the nest
Ran away into the woods howling
Ate the honey quietly and left
Went back to hunting for ripe berries
questions.evidence: sprang upon the log tooth and claw, to destroy the nest

questions.q: In 'The Bear and the Bees', how did the Bear finally save himself from the swarm?
choices: He dove into a pool of water
He climbed up a very tall tree
He hid deep inside a dark cave
He rolled over and over in the mud
questions.evidence: he was able to save himself only by diving into a pool of water

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Bear and the Bees'?
choices: Better to bear one hurt than to get angry and get many more
Sweet honey is worth any danger, even a swarm of bees
Bees working together are always stronger than a bear
Always look for berries in the woods and leave the honey alone
questions.evidence: It is wiser to bear a single injury in silence than to provoke a thousand by flying into a rage.

questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Leopard', what was the Leopard proud of?
choices: His glossy, spotted coat
His long, bushy tail
His sharp, clever mind
His loud, deep roar
questions.evidence: The Leopard was very proud of his glossy, spotted coat

questions.q: What did the Fox say was real beauty in 'The Fox and the Leopard'?
choices: Having smartness inside your head
Having a glossy spotted coat
Having a long white-tipped tail
Having the loudest voice in the woods
questions.evidence: if you had a little more smartness inside your head

questions.q: In 'The Heron', why did the Heron end up eating only a tiny Snail?
choices: He was too picky, and the fish swam away
He did not like the taste of fish at all
The Perch bit his beak and he let it go
Another bird flew down and took his fish
questions.evidence: The Heron saw no more fish, and very glad was he at last to breakfast on a tiny Snail.

questions.q: In 'The Cock and the Fox', what 'wonderful news' did the Fox tell the Cock?
choices: All the animals had agreed to live in peace
There was a great feast that night in the barnyard
The Dogs had all gone away to the town
The farmer had left the henhouse gate open
questions.evidence: agreed to forget their differences and live in peace and friendship

questions.q: In 'The Cock and the Fox', how did the Cock trick the Fox into leaving?
choices: He said he saw Dogs coming
He flew down and pecked him
He crowed to wake the farmer
He said the news was false
questions.evidence: it looks to me like a couple of Dogs coming this way

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Cock and the Fox'?
choices: The trickster is easily tricked
Always believe any good news
Never sleep high in a tree
Dogs and foxes are friends
